**Best call: phox2bb/phox2a+ developing autonomic/enteric nervous-system neuron or progenitor; deepest defensible tier is neural-crest–derived peripheral/autonomic neuron, with enteric favored but not exclusive.**

## Evidence
- **phox2bb** — strong autonomic/ENS evidence: acts in enteric nervous system development and sympathetic ganglion development; expressed in digestive system, nervous system, neuroepithelial cell, and presumptive ENS [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-050407-3). ZFA defines presumptive ENS as developing from vagal neural crest [record](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0001334). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-050407-3?utm_source=openai))
- **hoxb5b** — supports vagal neural-crest/enteric-progenitor hypothesis: elevated Hoxb5b expands vagal NCC markers including **phox2bb** and yields supernumerary Phox2b+ enteric neural progenitors [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-PUB-220219-4). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-PUB-220219-4?utm_source=openai))
- **phox2a** — alternative hypothesis: cranial/autonomic ganglion neurons. ZFIN expression includes cranial ganglion, hindbrain, locus coeruleus, oculomotor/trochlear motor nuclei, and trunk ganglion [record](https://zfin.org/action/expression/fish-expression-figure-summary?fishID=ZDB-FISH-150901-5103&imagesOnly=false). Epibranchial ganglion is a cranial ganglion and lists **phox2a** among genes with expression figures [record](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0001555). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/action/expression/fish-expression-figure-summary?fishID=ZDB-FISH-150901-5103&imagesOnly=false&utm_source=openai))
- **gap43** — neuronal differentiation/axon growth state: zebrafish Gap43 is associated with nerve growth and growth-cone membranes [record](https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q90462/entry); GO axonogenesis is generation of a neuronal axon [record](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO%3A0007409). ([uniprot.org](https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q90462/entry?utm_source=openai))
- **slit3/nrp1a** — axon-guidance/neuron-projection support, but not cell-type-specific: **slit3** is predicted in axon guidance [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-010306-4); **nrp1a** acts in axon development and neuron-projection regulation and is expressed in cranial neural crest/nervous system [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030519-2). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-010306-4?utm_source=openai))

## Caveats
- Enteric is favored by **phox2bb+hoxb5b**, but **phox2a** keeps cranial/autonomic ganglion neurons plausible.
- Lacking definitive enteric subtype markers here; do not overcall mature enteric neuron.

**Verdict:** neural-crest-derived autonomic/enteric neuron or progenitor, progenitor/developing — confidence medium**

**Most likely identity: floor plate / ventral neural-tube midline glial signaling cells, likely differentiated/mature rather than cycling.**

## Evidence
- **shha** — strong floor-plate marker; ZFIN expression repeatedly includes floor plate, and classic figure notes trunk expression “exclusively in the floor plate” [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-FIG-100909-1). GO corroborates Hedgehog/Smoothened signaling in ventral neural-tube patterning [record](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO%3A0007224).
- **nkx2.2b** — ZFIN describes action in floor plate formation and ventral spinal-cord interneuron differentiation; publication evidence calls it a strong, relatively specific lateral floor plate marker [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-050217-3).
- **ntn1b** — curated ZFIN expression includes floor plate and floor plate neural tube; function fits axon guidance/neurite projection cues from ventral midline [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990415-168). GO axon guidance captures this cue function [record](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO%3A0007411).
- **ntn1a** — ZFIN expression includes floor plate rhombomere 4 / floor plate rhombomere region, supporting floor-plate identity, especially hindbrain floor plate [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990415-169/expression).
- **spon1b** — ZFA floor plate page lists spon1b among genes with multiple floor-plate expression figures [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-TERM-100331-21).
- **ZFA floor plate** — defined as the ventral-most developing neural tube, a specialized secretory glial structure [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-TERM-100331-21). GO “floor plate formation” defines a ventral neural-tube glial region providing inductive signals [record](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO%3A0021508).

## Caveats
- **nkx2.2b** can also mark p3 progenitor cells, so medial/lateral floor plate vs adjacent ventral progenitors is not fully separable from these markers alone.

**Verdict:** floor plate glial signaling cell, mature — confidence high

([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-166))
- **ntn1b / ntn1a** — secreted basement-membrane/extracellular axon-guidance ligands; ntn1b is expressed in CNS, forebrain neural rod, hypochord, neural plate, and head, while ntn1a is expressed broadly including brain, optic structures, somite, and neural tube [ntn1b](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990415-168), [ntn1a](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990415-169). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990415-168?utm_source=openai))
- **spon1b** — extracellular/cell-adhesion-associated, expressed in axis, CNS, eye, mesoderm, and pancreatic system; this keeps axial-mesoderm/hypochord alternatives alive [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-000427-10). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-000427-10?utm_source=openai))
- **lrrn1 / metrnla** — neural/placodal support rather than specificity: lrrn1 is expressed in neural plate/hindbrain neural keel/nervous system; metrnla in axis, CNS, otic placode, pronephric duct, and segmental plate [lrrn1](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-071126-1), [metrnla](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-040426-1917). **Most likely: developing olfactory/neural sensory progenitor, not a mature olfactory receptor neuron.**

## Evidence
- **neurod4** — proneural bHLH TF; expressed in nervous system/neural plate/tube and specifically in olfactory anlage, supporting neurogenic sensory progenitors [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030730-1). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030730-1?utm_source=openai))
- **ebf2** — curated expression includes olfactory system; consistent with olfactory/neural differentiation context [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990715-11/expression). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990715-11/expression?utm_source=openai))
- **dlb** — deltaB/Notch-ligand gene, expressed in nervous system and neural plate; Notch-linked marker favors neural progenitor/lateral-inhibition state rather than terminal neuron [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-114). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-114))
- **vim** — vimentin; expressed in neural tube/nervous system and predicted cytoskeletal/intermediate-filament component, fitting immature neuroepithelial/radial-like cells [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-011212-3). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-011212-3?utm_source=openai))
- **alcama** — expressed broadly in nervous system/immature eye and located in axon; supports neural/neuronal developmental context but is not cell-type-specific [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990415-30). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990415-30?utm_source=openai))
- ZFA **olfactory epithelium** is the nasal sensory epithelium containing olfactory receptor neurons, supporting cells, and basal cells; ZFA **olfactory receptor cell** appears from 10–13 somites to adult, but mature ORN markers are not in this list [record](https://zfin.org/ZFA:0000554), [record](https://zfin.org/ZFA:0009125). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0000554?utm_source=openai))
- GO support: **neurod4** is predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription-factor/E-box binding activity and acts in neural plate morphogenesis/olfactory placode development; **dlb** is predicted Notch-binding, aligning with neurogenic progenitor signaling [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030730-1), [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-114). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030730-1?utm_source=openai))

## Caveats
- No provided marker is a definitive mature olfactory receptor neuron receptor/OMP-like marker.
- alcama and vim are broad developmental markers, so tissue call is moderate-confidence.

**Verdict:** olfactory sensory/neural progenitor, progenitor — confidence medium**

## Evidence
- **neurod4** — strong proneural evidence: ZFIN lists expression in nervous system, neural plate/tube, trigeminal neural crest, olfactory placode; GO supports DNA-binding transcription-factor activity, fitting differentiating neural progenitors/neuroblasts. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030730-1) [record](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO:0003700)
- **ebf2** — supports early CNS/placodal alternatives: curated WT expression spans neural plate, hindbrain/midbrain neural rod/keel, spinal cord neural plate neuroblast, olfactory field, trigeminal placode, and later brain regions. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990715-11/expression)
- **dlb** — Notch/Delta-type signaling marker: ZFIN protein domains include DSL and Notch-ligand N-terminal domains, consistent with neural progenitor/neurogenic contexts rather than mature neurons alone. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-114)
- **tuba8l3** — alternative glial/myelinating hypothesis: ZFIN says it acts within glial cell development and myelination, and is expressed in brain, cranial ganglion, periventricular grey zone, retinal inner nuclear layer; GO gliogenesis includes glial progenitors through mature glia. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-040801-77) [record](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO:0042063)
- **alcama** — broad neural/axon adhesion support, not specific: ZFIN reports expression in nervous system and axonal localization, plus roles in neural crest differentiation and retina morphogenesis. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990415-30)
- **vim / gadd45gb.1** — immature/stress/progenitor-compatible but broad: both are expressed in nervous system/neural tube; gadd45gb.1 also implicates cell-cycle/stress MAPK regulation. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-011212-3) [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-040426-2321)

## Caveats
- **Olfactory hypothesis:** neurod4/ebf2 expression in olfactory placode/field and ZFA olfactory epithelium contains receptor neurons, support cells, and basal cells, but the cluster lacks mature olfactory receptor markers. [record](https://zfin.org/ZFA:0000554)
- **Retinal hypothesis:** neurod4/tuba8l3 touch bipolar/inner nuclear layer biology; ZFA confirms inner nuclear layer contains bipolar, amacrine, horizontal cells, but markers are not retinal-specific. [record](https://zfin.org/ZFA:0000119)

**Most likely: cholinergic motor neuron, mature/post-mitotic — probably spinal/cranial motor rather than generic neuron.**

## Evidence
- **slc18a3a** — vesicular acetylcholine transporter paralog; ZFIN expression includes spinal cord neural-tube neurons and brain/spinal cord, supporting cholinergic neurons. GO “acetylcholine transmembrane transporter activity” fits this marker’s transmitter identity. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/action/marker/ZDB-GENE-060929-990/expression?utm_source=openai))
- **isl2a** — LIM-homeobox TF expressed in nervous system/neural tube; ZFIN phenotypes include CaP motoneuron axon defects and secondary motor neuron loss, supporting motor-neuron lineage. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-562?utm_source=openai))
- **isl1** — provided symbol maps best to zebrafish **isl1a**; the ZFA “primary motor neuron” term lists **isl1a** among genes with most expression figures, consistent with motor neuron identity. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0009244?utm_source=openai))
- **elavl3** — neuron-specific RNA-binding gene; ZFIN reports expression in nervous system, neural tube, neuronal stem cell, and neuron-related structures, supporting neuronal identity. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-76?utm_source=openai))
- **islr2** — expressed in nervous system; mutant phenotypes affect optic nerve/retinal ganglion-cell axon guidance, consistent with axon-projecting neurons rather than glia. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-050320-95?utm_source=openai))
- **stmn1b** — nervous-system/neural-tube expression and predicted roles in neuron projection development; GO neuron-projection development supports an axon-growth/differentiation program. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-050417-397?utm_source=openai))
- **ZFA support** — “primary motor neuron” is a zebrafish anatomy term for early motor neurons innervating myotomes; the term’s expression panel includes **isl1a**, **isl2a**, and **elavl3**. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0009244?utm_source=openai))

## Caveats
- No subtype marker cleanly distinguishes primary vs secondary, cranial vs spinal motor neuron.
- **tmsb/ptmaa** are broad growth/proliferation-associated markers, not decisive here.

Using ZFIN curated expression, ZFA anatomy, and GO, identify the most likely zebrafish cell type (with state if the markers support it), grounding each claim in a cited record. If the evidence is ambiguous, say so.

**Most likely: gfap⁺ radial glial / neural stem-like glial cell, probably quiescent-to-progenitor.**

## Evidence
- **gfap** — canonical glial/radial-glial marker; ZFA radial glial cells list **gfap** as the top associated expression gene, and the ZFA term defines radial glia as developing-CNS precursor/scaffold cells [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-TERM-100331-2349).
- **mdka** — expressed in nervous system/neural tube/neuroectoderm; adult-brain curated figure links mdka to ventricular layers, and the publication title associates mdka with **quiescent neural stem cells** [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990621-1), [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-FIG-220302-180).
- **slc1a3a** — described in curated literature as an **early glial marker**, supporting glial rather than neuronal identity [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-PUB-141123-6).
- **slc6a9** — expressed in CNS structures including hindbrain, optic tectum, spinal cord and fourth ventricle; GO-linked function is glycine transporter activity / glycine transport, compatible with CNS glial transporter biology but not cell-type-specific alone [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-050105-3).
- **her12** — Notch-pathway bHLH factor expressed in nervous system/neural plate; supports neural progenitor/radial-glial program rather than mature neuron [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-040824-5).
- **GO radial glial cell differentiation** — defines radial glia as specialized bipotential progenitor cells arising from neural tube neuroepithelium [record](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO%3A0060019).

## Caveats
- No single marker here uniquely separates radial glia from other astroglial/Müller-like glia without anatomical context.
- “Quiescent” is mainly supported by **mdka/gas1b-like** program, not by direct cell-cycle depletion data.

**Verdict:** radial glial cell / neural stem-like glia, quiescent-progenitor — confidence medium

- **mdka** — argues for neural stem/progenitor context: expressed in nervous system/neural tube/neuroectoderm; curated publications link mdka to adult telencephalic neural stem cells/radial glia and retinal progenitors. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990621-1?utm_source=openai))

**Premigratory/dorsal neural-crest–like progenitor, Notch-active — not a mature derivative.**

## Evidence
- **pax3a** — expressed in neural crest, neural tube, nervous system; involved in neural crest migration and xanthophore differentiation [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-52).
- **tfap2e** — expressed in neural crest cell, melanoblast, and nervous system; acts upstream of melanocyte differentiation [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-040426-1455).
- **dla** — Delta/Notch ligand; expressed in neural plate/keel/tube and nervous system; acts in nervous-system development and regulation of Notch signaling [record](https://www.zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-29).
- **lfng** — Notch-pathway modulator required for Delta-Notch-mediated developmental induction, supporting a progenitor/signaling state [record](https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q8JHF2/entry).
- **gsx1** — neurodevelopmental homeobox gene with expression reported in hindbrain/diencephalon and later tectum/pretectum/cerebellar plate, consistent with CNS progenitor adjacency rather than a mature crest derivative [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-041008-135).
- **neural crest** — ZFA defines it as a dorsolateral CNS-primordium cell population that later migrates to form pigment cells, peripheral neurons/glia, and head cartilage [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-TERM-100331-43).

## Caveats
- The set mixes neural-crest markers (**pax3a/tfap2e**) with CNS progenitor/Notch markers (**dla/lfng/gsx1**); without canonical **sox10/crestin/foxd3** in the provided markers, call remains medium confidence.
- **slc1a3a** and **fabp3** add neural/glial or metabolic signal but are not decisive here.

**Verdict:** premigratory/dorsal neural-crest-like progenitor, progenitor — confidence medium**

- **pax3a** — strong neural plate border / neural crest support: expressed in neural crest, neural tube, nervous system, and paraxial mesoderm; acts in neural crest migration [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-52). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-52?utm_source=openai))
- **tfap2e** — supports neural crest / melanoblast alternative: expressed in neural crest cell, melanoblast, and nervous system; acts in melanocyte differentiation [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-040426-1455). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-040426-1455?utm_source=openai))
- **dla** — supports neurogenic progenitor/Notch-active state: expressed in ectoderm, neural plate/keel/tube and nervous system; involved in Notch regulation and nervous system development [record](https://www.zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-29). ([zfin.org](https://www.zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-29?utm_source=openai))
- **lfng** — reinforces Notch/neurogenic progenitor interpretation: expressed in CNS/neural plate/sensory system and acts in negative regulation of neuron differentiation [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980605-16). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980605-16?utm_source=openai))
- **gsx1** — alternative forebrain/neural progenitor support: ZFIN links gsx genes to neurodevelopment and telencephalon/olfactory bulb expression contexts [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-041008-135). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-041008-135?utm_source=openai))
- **ZFA neural crest cell** — multipotent ectodermal neural-plate-border derivative; fits pax3a/tfap2e better than mature pigment identity alone [record](https://www.zfin.org/action/ontology/term/ZFA%3A0009165). ([zfin.org](https://www.zfin.org/action/ontology/term/ZFA%3A0009165?utm_source=openai))
- **ZFA radial glial cell** — plausible but weaker alternative: slc1a3a fits, yet radial glia are developing CNS precursor/scaffold cells and the cluster also has neural-crest-border markers [record](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0009292). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0009292?utm_source=openai))
- **fabp3** — argues for caution: associated with fatty-acid binding and cardiac development literature, but conflicts with the stronger neural/crest/Notch marker set [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-020318-2). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-020318-2?utm_source=openai))

**Most likely neural plate border / premigratory neural crest progenitor, not a mature neural/glial subtype.**

## Evidence
- **pax3a** — expressed in neural plate border, neural crest/neural tube; GO-linked TF involved in neural crest migration/differentiation [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-52). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-52?utm_source=openai))
- **olig3** — establishes trunk neural plate boundary; loss expands neural crest but removes lateral neural plate fates, fitting border progenitors [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-080903-1). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-080903-1?utm_source=openai))
- **msx1b** — WT expression includes neural plate border, neural crest, neural rod/tube, and vagal neural crest [record](https://zfin.org/action/marker/ZDB-GENE-980526-26/expression). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/action/marker/ZDB-GENE-980526-26/expression?utm_source=openai))
- **mdkb** — growth-factor gene expressed in neural keel/rod/tube and acts in brain development, neural crest formation, and neuron differentiation [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-010131-6). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-010131-6?utm_source=openai))
- **slc1a3a** — solute carrier 1 family glutamate transporter paralog; supports neuroectoderm/glial-neural context but is not specific enough alone [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030131-2159). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030131-2159?utm_source=openai))
- **ZFA anatomy** — cranial/vagal neural crest are defined neural crest structures, while neural plate-derived terms mark early developmental domains [record](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0001194). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0001194?utm_source=openai))
- **GO support** — pax3a/mdkb annotations implicate DNA-binding transcription-factor activity, neural crest migration/formation, and neuron differentiation [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-52). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-52?utm_source=openai))

## Caveats
- No canonical crestin/sox10/foxd3 marker was provided, so “premigratory/border progenitor” is safer than mature neural crest.
- **slc1a3a** could reflect glial/neural progenitor programs.

**Verdict:** neural plate border / premigratory neural crest progenitor — confidence medium

## Evidence
- **pax3a** — strongest neural-crest-border evidence: expressed in neural plate border, neural crest, neural tube, and paraxial mesoderm; GO links it to neural crest cell migration and xanthophore differentiation. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-52) ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-52?utm_source=openai))
- **msx1b** — supports neural plate border/neural crest alternative: expressed in neural crest and CNS; curated WT expression includes vagal neural crest and neural crest cell. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-26) ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-26?utm_source=openai))
- **olig3** — argues for neural/neuroepithelial identity rather than pure neural crest: expressed in brain, neural plate, neural tube, posterior neural keel, and presumptive diencephalon; GO-consistent bHLH transcription factor. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-080903-1) ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-080903-1?utm_source=openai))
- **slc1a3a** — raises glial/radial-glia-like alternative via glutamate transporter function, but ZFIN result here is less anatomically decisive than pax3a/msx1b/olig3. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030131-2159) ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030131-2159?utm_source=openai))
- **gdf10a** — alternative placodal/glial signal: expressed in neural plate early, olfactory/otic placodes, lateral line/neuromast, and day-5 Bergmann glial cell. [record](https://zfin.org/action/marker/ZDB-GENE-090312-17/expression) ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/action/marker/ZDB-GENE-090312-17/expression?utm_source=openai))
- **mdkb** — supports immature neural/neural-crest-associated state: expressed in brain, neural keel/rod/tube and retina; acts in neural crest formation and neuron differentiation. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-010131-6) ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-010131-6?utm_source=openai))

## Caveats
- **Alternative 1:** radial/Bergmann glial-like progenitor, driven by **slc1a3a** and **gdf10a**, but not enough mature glial specificity.
- **Alternative 2:** cranial placodal/lateral-line ectoderm, driven by **gdf10a**, but **pax3a/msx1b** weigh more toward neural plate border/neural crest.
- Deepest defensible tier: **tissue/early cell population**, not a mature cell type.

- **gfap** — curated zebrafish expression links gfap-driven reporters/anti-GFAP to glial cells, Müller glia and radial glia; spinal-cord gfap⁺ cells are explicitly described as radial glia and progenitors for later neurons/glia. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-PUB-160422-3) ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-PUB-160422-3?utm_source=openai))

- **gfap** — GO/NCBI annotates zebrafish gfap to “structural constituent of cytoskeleton,” “intermediate filament organization,” and intermediate/type III intermediate filament localization, matching a glial filament program. [record](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/gene/30646) ([ncbi.nlm.nih.gov](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/gene/30646?utm_source=openai))
- **vim** — zebrafish vimentin is expressed in nervous system/neural tube/spinal cord and is predicted as a cytoskeletal structural constituent, consistent with immature/radial glial intermediate-filament identity. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-011212-3) ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-011212-3?utm_source=openai))
- **rpsa** — ribosomal protein SA supports high translational/ribosomal activity, not lineage by itself; compatible with progenitor activity but not diagnostic. [record](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/gene/394027) ([ncbi.nlm.nih.gov](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/gene/394027?utm_source=openai))
- **hmgb2a/hmgb2b** — chromatin-associated markers suggest active/progenitor-like state, but I would not call “cycling” without explicit cell-cycle markers.

## Caveats

This favors epithelial/periderm/fin epithelium over mesenchyme. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030411-5?utm_source=openai))
- **krt18a.1** — Also epithelial/periderm-weighted: expressed in EVL, periderm, head, cardiovascular system, and pleuroperitoneal region; supports a simple epithelial identity but is not fin-specific. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030411-6?utm_source=openai))
- **hoxc13a / hoxc13b** — Posterior/fin signal: hoxc13a is expressed in median fin fold, post-vent region, pronephros, tail bud; hoxc13b in caudal fin, post-vent region, tail bud, and both act within fin regeneration. These strongly shift the epithelial call toward posterior fin-fold/caudal-fin territory. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-000822-4?utm_source=openai))
- **hoxb13a** — Adds posterior axial/caudal HOX context; GO supports these HOX markers as DNA-binding transcription-factor activity, but that is positional/developmental, not a cell type by itself. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-050812-1?utm_source=openai))
- **rarga** — Ambiguous: expressed in CNS, germ ring, gonad, mesoderm, neural crest, and caudal-fin blastema after amputation; GO nuclear receptor activity supports retinoid-response/developmental regulation, not a specific epithelial lineage. **Most likely: neural progenitor / early differentiating neuroblast, Notch-active neurogenic state.**

## Evidence
- **dla** — DeltaA is a Notch ligand; expressed in nervous system, neural keel/plate/tube, and acts in nervous system development/regulation of Notch signaling. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-29?utm_source=openai))
- **dlb** — DeltaB is another predicted Notch ligand; expressed in nervous system and neural plate, supporting a neurogenic Notch-ligand program. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-114?utm_source=openai))
- **notch1a** — Notch receptor; involved in Notch signaling, cell differentiation in spinal cord, and regulation of cell fate specification; expressed in nervous system. ([zfin.org](https://www.zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990415-173?utm_source=openai))
- **neurod4** — proneural bHLH TF; expressed in nervous system, neural plate/tube, retina, olfactory placode/epithelium; predicted to act in neural plate morphogenesis and olfactory placode development. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030730-1?utm_source=openai))
- **GO support** — Notch signaling is ligand–Notch receptor signaling ending in downstream regulation, consistent with dla/dlb/notch1a; neuron differentiation is acquisition of neuronal features by an unspecialized cell, consistent with neurod4. ([amigo.geneontology.org](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO%3A0007219?utm_source=openai))
- **ZFA/anatomy support** — the recurrent ZFIN-curated expression sites are neural plate, neural keel, neural tube, and nervous system, not a mature subtype-specific structure. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-29?utm_source=openai))

## Caveats
- Markers support neurogenic identity broadly, but not a specific neuron subtype.
- Notch ligand/receptor co-expression could reflect lateral-inhibition progenitors rather than fully committed neurons.

**Verdict:** neural progenitor / early neuroblast, progenitor — confidence medium

## Evidence
- **neurod4** — strongest neural/neuronal clue: expressed in neural plate, neural tube, nervous system, olfactory placode, and retinal neuron classes; GO-linked as a bHLH DNA-binding transcription factor and involved upstream of neural plate morphogenesis/olfactory placode development [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030730-1), [expression](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030730-1/expression), [GO](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO%3A0000981).
- **dla** — supports lateral-inhibition/neurogenic Notch signaling; ZFIN links deltaA to inner-ear hair-cell lateral inhibition and primary motor neuron expression, so an alternative is sensory/otic neuroepithelium rather than generic CNS [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-PUB-000201-15), [anatomy](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0009244).
- **dlb** — Notch ligand expressed in ectoderm, neural plate, nervous system, adenohypophyseal placode, digestive system; this broadens the hypothesis to neurogenic/placodal progenitors, not mature neurons [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-114), [GO](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO%3A0007219).
- **notch1a** — receptor expressed in nervous system, mesoderm, digestive system, fin, tail bud; involved in cell fate specification and spinal-cord differentiation, favoring progenitor/neurogenic state over terminal neuron [record](https://www.zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990415-173), [GO](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO%3A0007219).
- **gadd45gb.1** — expressed in nervous system, neural tube, optic vesicle; predicted roles in cell-cycle regulation/JNK/p38, compatible with developmental/stress or differentiation-associated neural cells but not diagnostic [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-040426-2321).
- **ZFA context** — neural plate is the earliest recognizable CNS primordium; neural tube is later CNS primordium; olfactory placode is neurogenic and gives rise to olfactory neurons [record](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0000132), [record](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0001135), [record](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0000048).

## Caveats
- Alternative hypotheses: **placodal sensory neuroepithelium/early olfactory or otic lineage** is plausible from **neurod4**, **dla**, and **dlb**, but the marker set lacks subtype anchors to defend olfactory, otic, retinal, or motor-neuron identity.
- Deepest defensible tier: **neuroectodermal/neurogenic tissue**, possibly **neural plate/neural tube progenitor/early differentiating neuron**; exact cell type is ambiguous.

**Verdict:** neurogenic neural plate/neural tube population, progenitor — confidence medium

**Cycling/proliferating zebrafish cells, not a specific lineage — state: cycling.**

## Evidence
- **mki67** — canonical proliferation-associated marker; ZFIN describes zebrafish *mki67* as “marker of proliferation Ki-67,” involved in regulation of mitotic nuclear division and expressed in multiple structures including blood/head/ventral mesoderm [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030131-9771).
- **cdc20** — mitotic APC/C activator; ZFIN places it in anaphase-promoting-complex processes and expression in a “proliferative region,” supporting active cell-cycle progression [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-040426-2044).
- **cenpf** — centromere/kinetochore-associated mitotic gene; ZFIN reports expression in “proliferative region” and activity at centromeric chromosome/nucleus/spindle pole [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-041111-205).
- **ccnb1** — G2/M cyclin; ZFIN links it to cyclin-dependent kinase regulator activity and broad expression across gonad, nervous system, pectoral fin, trunk mesenchyme and egg [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-000406-10).
- **GO support** — the marker set coheres around **mitotic cell cycle**, defined as progression through G1/S/G2/M with genome replication and chromosome segregation [record](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO%3A0000278).
- **ZFA support** — the safest anatomical target is generic **cell** rather than a lineage-specific ZFA cell type, since ZFA defines “cell” broadly and the markers are cell-cycle rather than tissue-identity markers [record](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0009000).

## Caveats
- No provided marker is lineage-diagnostic; ZFIN expression is broad/proliferative, not enough to call neural, blood, germline, etc.
- Best annotation is a state class, not a mature cell type.

**Verdict:** proliferating/cycling cell — confidence high

## Evidence
- **nkx2.2b** — acts upstream of floor plate formation and ventral spinal cord interneuron differentiation; expressed in CNS/trunk [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-050217-3). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-050217-3))

([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/action/marker/ZDB-GENE-990415-168/expression))
- **col4a6 / col4a5** — type IV collagen basement-membrane ECM genes; col4a6 acts in basement membrane organization and axon extension, while col4a5 is active in extracellular matrix and expressed in nervous system/neural tube [col4a6](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-101001-2), [col4a5](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030131-2281). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-101001-2?utm_source=openai))
- **ZFA: floor plate** — defined as ventral-most developing neural tube and a specialized glial structure with secretory function, matching nkx2.2b/ntn1b/Wnt/ECM profile [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-TERM-100331-21). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-TERM-100331-21))

Using ZFIN curated expression, ZFA anatomy, and GO, identify the most likely zebrafish cell type (with state if the markers support it), grounding each claim in a cited record. If the evidence is ambiguous, say so.

**Most consistent with zic1⁺ cerebellar/dorsal CNS neural progenitor-like cells; identity is weakly supported because most other UP markers are ribosomal.**

## Evidence
- **zic1** — curated expression includes CNS developmental domains: neural keel/plate/rod, presumptive neural plate, and central nervous system; GO-linked description predicts DNA-binding transcription-factor activity and roles in brain development [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-000208-4).
- **zic1** — curated expression includes cerebellum and granular layer corpus cerebelli at larval stages, supporting a cerebellar granule-lineage/progenitor interpretation [record](https://zfin.org/action/marker/ZDB-GENE-000208-4/expression).
- **zic1** — a curated figure explicitly describes zic1 as a “granule cell progenitor marker” in wild-type cerebellum at 48 hpf [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-FIG-200921-3).
- **cerebellum** — ZFA defines zebrafish cerebellum as an anterior-hindbrain brain structure, appearing from 26+ somites through adult [record](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0000100).
- **rpl38** — ribosomal protein with predicted structural constituent of ribosome activity; supports high translation/protein-synthesis state, not a specific lineage [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030131-8752).
- **si:dkey-151g10.6** — maps in ZFIN nomenclature history to **rpl41-201**, another ribosomal transcript; not cell-type specific [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-TSCRIPT-090929-21969).

## Caveats
- Only **zic1** is lineage-informative; the remaining markers are mostly ribosomal, so “progenitor” is plausible but not definitive.
- No canonical co-markers such as **atoh1a/neurod1** were provided for this cluster.

**Verdict:** cerebellar/dorsal CNS neural progenitor-like cell, progenitor — confidence medium

## Evidence
- **zic1** — strongest identity marker: curated as expressed in CNS, neural keel/plate/rod and presumptive neural plate; GO supports DNA-binding transcription factor activity tied to transcriptional regulation. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-000208-4?utm_source=openai))
- **zic1** — supports an **alternative cerebellar granule-cell progenitor** hypothesis: a curated figure describes zic1 as a “granule cell progenitor marker” in cerebellum at 48 hpf, but this is stage/anatomy-specific and not proven by the rest of this marker set. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-FIG-200921-3?utm_source=openai))
- **zic1** — supports anterior/dorsal CNS rather than a generic ectoderm call: expression records include anterior neural plate/keel/rod, hindbrain dorsal region, MHB, telencephalon, spinal cord neural tube, and cerebellum. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/action/marker/ZDB-GENE-000208-4/expression?utm_source=openai))
- **neural plate** — deepest anatomy I can defend: ZFA defines it as earliest recognizable dorsal ectodermal primordium of the CNS before neural keel formation. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0000132?utm_source=openai))
- **rpl38 / rpl41 / rplp1 / rpl39 / rps29 / rpl29 / rpl36a** — ribosomal-heavy signature supports high translation/growth but is not cell-type-specific; GO defines structural constituent of ribosome. ([amigo.geneontology.org](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO%3A0003735?utm_source=openai))

## Caveats
- Only **zic1** is lineage-informative; the other top markers are ribosomal.
- I would not call a mature neuron, glia, or specific cerebellar granule lineage without additional markers.

**Verdict:** neural plate / CNS progenitor-like cell, progenitor — confidence medium

transcript.content: Cluster 69's top up-regulated markers are: nkx2.4b, nkx2.4a, prdx1, shha, pitx2, id3, nell2a, marcksl1a. Using ZFIN curated expression, ZFA anatomy, and GO, identify the most likely zebrafish cell type (with state if the markers support it), grounding each claim in a cited record. If the evidence is ambiguous, say so.

**Most likely: nkx2.4/shha-positive hypothalamic neuroepithelial/progenitor cells, possibly ventral/intermediate hypothalamus — confidence medium.**

## Evidence
- **nkx2.4b** — strong anchor: curated expression includes hypothalamus, anterior/posterior/intermediate hypothalamus and caudal tuberculum; nkx2.4b transgene was designed to label hypothalamus/thyroid domains [record](https://zfin.org/action/marker/ZDB-GENE-000830-1/expression). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/action/marker/ZDB-GENE-000830-1/expression?utm_source=openai))
- **nkx2.4a** — paralog supports same regional call: expressed in diencephalon/forebrain/hypothalamus and acts within hypothalamus development [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030131-6336). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030131-6336?utm_source=openai))
- **shha** — co-marks ventral CNS patterning domains; curated expression includes hypothalamus/preoptic area/floor plate, and GO supports Hedgehog signaling involvement in nervous-system development [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-166/expression). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-166/expression?utm_source=openai))
- **ZFA hypothalamus** — ventral diencephalic structure arising around 22–24 hpf; ZFIN lists nkx2.4b and shha among genes with many hypothalamus expression figures [record](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0000032). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0000032?utm_source=openai))
- **GO:0021854** — “hypothalamus development” is the progression of the hypothalamus from initial formation to mature state, fitting nkx2.4a/b developmental TF signal [record](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO%3A0021854). ([amigo.geneontology.org](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO%3A0021854?utm_source=openai))
- **prdx1** — oxidative/Nrf2-responsive antioxidant marker; may indicate stress/redox state but is not cell-type specific [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-050320-35/expression). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-050320-35/expression?utm_source=openai))

## Caveats
- No mature neuronal subtype marker is present; call should remain regional/progenitor-like.
- Thyroid is possible from nkx2.4b, but nkx2.4a + shha + nell2a/id3 favor CNS/hypothalamus.

**Verdict:** hypothalamic neuroepithelial/progenitor cell, progenitor — confidence medium**

**Best defensible call: ventral forebrain/hypothalamic neuroepithelial or signaling-domain cells; alternatives are thyroid primordium and floor plate/ZLI-like Shh signaling cells.**

## Evidence
- **nkx2.4b** — strongest for hypothalamus: expressed in hypothalamus/forebrain and also thyroid primordium; targeted reporter is specific to hypothalamus and thyroid, so it does **not** by itself choose between those two. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-000830-1) ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/action/marker/ZDB-GENE-000830-1/expression?utm_source=openai))
- **nkx2.4a** — supports hypothalamic/diencephalic identity: curated expression in caudal tuberculum, diencephalon, forebrain, hypothalamus, and intermediate hypothalamus. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030131-6336) ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030131-6336?utm_source=openai))
- **shha** — argues for a signaling organizer/ventral midline program: curated in hypothalamus, floor plate, and ZLI; GO supports Smoothened/Hedgehog signaling rather than a terminal neuronal subtype. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-166/expression) ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-166/expression?utm_source=openai))
- **Hypothalamus hypothesis** — ZFA defines hypothalamus as ventral diencephalon, and its expression table lists **nkx2.4b** and **shha** among frequent genes; this best matches the combined nkx2.4a/b + shha profile. [record](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0000032) ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0000032?utm_source=openai))
- **Alternative: thyroid primordium/follicular lineage** — plausible because **nkx2.4b** is expressed in thyroid primordium/follicle and required for thyroid development, but **nkx2.4a** and **nell2a** point more CNS than endoderm. [record](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0001081) ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0001081?utm_source=openai))
- **Alternative: floor plate/ZLI Shh organizer** — **shha** fits floor plate and ZLI, but nkx2.4a/b evidence is more hypothalamic/forebrain; ZFA floor plate is ventral neural tube glial/secretory structure. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-TERM-100331-21) ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-TERM-100331-21?utm_source=openai))
- **nell2a** — broad CNS/otic expression; supports neural tissue but not a precise hypothalamic cell type. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030131-7972) ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030131-7972?utm_source=openai))

## Caveats
- Deepest defensible tier is **tissue/domain**, not mature cell type.
- No provided terminal neuroendocrine or thyroid-follicle markers.

**Verdict:** ventral hypothalamic/forebrain Shh-signaling domain, progenitor — confidence medium**

## Evidence
- **fabp7a** — expressed in nervous system/neural tube, and the radial glial cell anatomy term lists **fabp7a** expression; ZFA defines radial glia as CNS precursor/scaffold cells [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-000627-1), [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-TERM-100331-2349). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-000627-1?utm_source=openai))

([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030131-7779?utm_source=openai))
- **atp1a1b** — expressed in CNS/neural tube; Na⁺/K⁺ transporter supports ion-homeostatic glial/neural progenitor physiology [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-001212-5). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-001212-5))
- **slc6a1b** — nervous-system expression and predicted GABA:sodium:chloride symporter activity; supports neural/glial transporter phenotype, but is not by itself radial-glia-specific [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-041114-57). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-041114-57))
- **mdkb** — expressed in brain/neural keel/neural rod/neural tube/retina and involved in brain development/neuron differentiation; consistent with neural progenitor niches [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-010131-6). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-010131-6?utm_source=openai))
- **ptn** — curated expression in ventricular zone, forebrain/telencephalon, hindbrain and brain; supports a CNS ventricular progenitor/radial-glial context [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030624-1/expression). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030624-1/expression?utm_source=openai))

**Most likely radial glial / neural stem–progenitor glial cell, with possible early glial/oligodendroglial bias — confidence medium.**

## Evidence
- **fabp7a** — brain fatty-acid-binding marker; ZFIN links it to nervous system/neural tube expression, and curated anatomy lists **fabp7a** among genes expressed in **radial glial cell** ([record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-000627-1), [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-TERM-100331-2349)).
- **notch3** — supports a progenitor/quiescence program: ZFIN publication record describes Notch3 signaling as promoting adult zebrafish neural stem-cell quiescence/stemness ([record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-PUB-180427-2)).
- **slc1a2b** — glutamate transporter/Eaat2b-family signal consistent with glial glutamate handling; mutant phenotypes include telencephalic extracellular glutamate increase and altered neuronal action-potential regulation ([record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030131-7779)).
- **plp1a** — strong oligodendrocyte/myelin evidence: ZFIN expression includes CNS glial cell, neural tube, CNS myelin sheath, and forebrain oligodendrocyte; ZFA defines oligodendrocytes as CNS macroglia forming myelin sheath ([record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-001202-1/wt-expression), [record](https://zfin.org/ZFA:0009076)).
- **nfia** — transcription-factor marker; GO annotations support DNA-binding/RNA polymerase II transcription-factor activity, compatible with developmental glial progenitor identity rather than terminal myelin alone ([record](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/gene/556665)).
- **ZFA radial glial cell** — defined as developing-CNS transient precursor/scaffold cell, matching fabp7a + notch3 + nfia better than mature oligodendrocyte alone ([record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-TERM-100331-2349)).

## Caveats
- **plp1a** pulls toward oligodendrocyte/myelinating glia, but fabp7a/notch3/nfia argue progenitor/radial-glial state.
- CU loci are uninformative without curated marker identity here.

**Verdict:** radial glial cell, progenitor/quiescent-leaning — confidence medium

transcript.content: Cluster 73's top up-regulated markers are: sst1.1, pkd2l1, nppc, pkd1l2a, egr4, txn, gad1b, msi2b. Using ZFIN curated expression, ZFA anatomy, and GO, identify the most likely zebrafish cell type (with state if the markers support it), grounding each claim in a cited record. If the evidence is ambiguous, say so.

**Most likely: spinal cerebrospinal-fluid-contacting neuron (CSF-cN), GABAergic mature/sensory neuron.**

## Evidence
- **pkd2l1** — expressed in ependymal/spinal cord neural tube; curated figure calls pkd2l1 a specific marker of spinal CSF-contacting neurons, with rows of spinal-cord cells in embryo/adult [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-FIG-150504-33). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030616-558?utm_source=openai))
- **gad1b** — glutamate decarboxylase gene expressed in nervous system/neural tube; supports GABAergic identity [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030909-3). GO: glutamate decarboxylase activity produces GABA from glutamate [record](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO:0004351). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030909-3?utm_source=openai))
- **sst1.1** — somatostatin neuropeptide gene expressed in nervous system and endocrine system, consistent with a peptidergic neuronal subclass [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030131-4743). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030131-4743?utm_source=openai))
- **pkd1l2a** — predicted calcium-channel/mechanosensory gene expressed in spinal cord; reinforces a sensory spinal neuron program [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-050208-89). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-050208-89?utm_source=openai))
- **ZFA:0007120** — CSF-cN is defined as a spinal cord interneuron along the central canal, GABAergic, PKD2L1+, chemo/mechanosensory [record](https://zfin.org/ZFA:0007120). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0007120))
- **ZFA:0009276** — GABAergic neuron is a neuron using GABA as vesicular neurotransmitter [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-TERM-100331-2333). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-TERM-100331-2333))

## Caveats
- **nppc** points to peptide signaling but is not CSF-cN-specific in ZFIN.
- **msi2b/txn/egr4** do not by themselves sharpen the cell-type call.

**Verdict:** cerebrospinal-fluid-contacting neuron, mature — confidence high

## Evidence
- **pkd2l1** — strongest discriminator: expressed in ependymal cell/spinal cord/neural tube and acts in mechanosensory behavior; ZFIN figure calls pkd2l1 a marker of spinal CSF-contacting neurons [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030616-558), [record](https://www.zfin.org/ZDB-FIG-150504-33). GO supports cation-channel/mechanosensory function [record](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO%3A0005261), [record](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO%3A0007638).
- **sst1.1** — curated expression includes Kolmer–Agduhr neuron medial and ventro-medial regions, directly matching the leading hypothesis [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030131-4743/wt-expression).
- **gad1b** — supports GABAergic neuronal identity: expressed in nervous system/neural tube and acts in GABA biosynthesis [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030909-3); GO defines glutamate decarboxylase activity and GABA biosynthetic process [record](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO%3A0004351), [record](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO%3A0009449).
- **ZFA anatomy** — Kolmer–Agduhr neurons are ciliated GABAergic neurons contacting the spinal-cord central canal, i.e. dorsal CSF-cNs [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-TERM-100331-1915).
- **nppc** — alternative vascular/neuroendocrine clue: reported in brain, heart, vasculature and angiogenesis; but this conflicts less than it competes, because pkd2l1+sst1.1+gad1b are more specific for CSF-cN [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-PUB-170222-14).

## Caveats
- Deepest defensible tier is **cell type**, but subtype is specifically **KA/CSF-cN** only if spinal/ependymal context is present.
- **pkd1l2a/egr4/txn/msi2b** need follow-up; current call rests mainly on pkd2l1, sst1.1, gad1b.

**Verdict:** Kolmer–Agduhr / CSF-contacting GABAergic neuron, mature — confidence medium

transcript.content: Cluster 74's top up-regulated markers are: dbx1a, dlb, ebf2, scrt2, gadd45gb.1, hes6, si:ch211-222l21.1, neurod4. Using ZFIN curated expression, ZFA anatomy, and GO, identify the most likely zebrafish cell type (with state if the markers support it), grounding each claim in a cited record. If the evidence is ambiguous, say so.

**Most likely: developing neural tube / spinal interneuron-lineage neuroblast, progenitor-to-differentiating state.**

## Evidence
- **dbx1a** — expressed in brain/neural tube/posterior neural rod; acts in spinal-cord cell differentiation, supporting a dorsal/ventral neural progenitor–interneuron lineage [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-000128-8). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-000128-8?utm_source=openai))
- **dlb** — Notch ligand; expressed in nervous system/neural plate, consistent with neurogenic progenitor signaling rather than mature neuron alone [record](https://www.zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-114). ([zfin.org](https://www.zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-114?utm_source=openai))
- **ebf2** — neural transcription factor expressed in brain, hindbrain neural rod, midbrain neural keel, neural plate, and posterior neural keel [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990715-11). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990715-11))
- **scrt2** — neuronal Scratch-family repressor expressed in nervous system and spinal cord neural tube; involved in neural precursor proliferation and neuron apoptosis regulation [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030131-4097). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030131-4097?utm_source=openai))
- **neurod4** — pro-neural differentiation factor expressed in nervous system, neural plate, and neural tube; GO-level fit is “neuron differentiation” [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030730-1), [record](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO%3A0030182). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030730-1?utm_source=openai))
- **ZFA neural tube** — CNS primordium developing from neural rod; **posterior neural tube** gives rise to hindbrain and spinal cord [record](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0001135), [record](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0007037). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0001135?utm_source=openai))

## Caveats
- Markers support neural tube/interneuron-lineage identity, but not a single mature interneuron subtype.
- No down-regulated marker list was provided to rule out alternatives.

**Verdict:** neural tube neuroblast / spinal interneuron-lineage progenitor, differentiating — confidence medium**

transcript.content: Cluster 75's top up-regulated markers are: slc32a1, lhx1a, stx1b, pax2a, stxbp1a, slc6a5, sncgb, calm1a. Using ZFIN curated expression, ZFA anatomy, and GO, identify the most likely zebrafish cell type (with state if the markers support it), grounding each claim in a cited record. If the evidence is ambiguous, say so.

**Most likely: mature inhibitory interneuron, probably glycinergic/GABAergic spinal/CNS interneuron.**

## Evidence
- **slc32a1** — vesicular inhibitory amino-acid transporter; expressed in inhibitory interneuron, brain, spinal cord; GO implicates GABA/glycine transport and synaptic-vesicle loading [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-061201-1), [GO](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/term/GO%3A0015812).
- **slc6a5** — glycine transporter GlyT2; expressed in CNS and glycinergic neurons; supports glycinergic inhibitory identity [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-050105-2).
- **pax2a** — neural developmental TF; ZFIN anatomy links pax2a expression to spinal cord interneuron, and candidate anatomy term is “CNS interneuron located in spinal cord” [gene](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990415-8), [anatomy](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0000778).
- **lhx1a** — LIM-homeobox TF with lhx1a reporter resources; compatible with neuronal subtype patterning but not by itself diagnostic here [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-347).
- **stx1b / stxbp1a** — synaptic vesicle release machinery; expressed in nervous system and active at presynaptic/exocytotic compartments, supporting mature synaptic neuron state [stx1b](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-000330-4), [stxbp1a](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-050626-106), [GO exocytosis](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/GTerm?id=GO%3A0006887).
- **sncgb** — nervous-system/axon-terminal-associated marker; supportive of neuronal identity, not subtype-specific [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-050522-235).

## Caveats
- pax2a/lhx1a can mark developmental domains; without down-regulated markers or stage, exact interneuron subtype is unresolved.
- slc32a1 + slc6a5 favors inhibitory glycinergic/GABAergic neuron over excitatory neuron.

**Verdict:** inhibitory glycinergic/GABAergic interneuron, mature — confidence medium

## Evidence
- **slc32a1** — vesicular inhibitory amino-acid transporter; expressed in inhibitory interneuron, spinal cord, brain; GO implicates GABA/glycine vesicle loading → strongest inhibitory-neuron evidence [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-061201-1).
- **slc6a5** — glycine transporter; curated expression includes glycinergic neuron, spinal cord glycinergic neuron, spinal cord inhibitory interneuron, and hindbrain neuron [record](https://zfin.org/action/marker/ZDB-GENE-050105-2/expression).
- **pax2a** — nervous-system developmental TF; expressed in nervous system/neural keel, but also pronephros/eye/mesoderm, so it supports Pax2-lineage neural identity but is not cell-type-specific alone [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990415-8).
- **pax2a + slc6a5** — curated figure summaries place pax2a-associated inhibitory markers, including slc6a5, in spinal cord interneurons, supporting the spinal interneuron hypothesis over non-neural Pax2 tissues [record](https://zfin.org/action/expression/fish-expression-figure-summary?fishID=ZDB-FISH-150901-26986&imagesOnly=false).
- **ZFA spinal cord interneuron** — defined as a CNS interneuron located in spinal cord; term lists pax2a and slc6a5 among genes with expression figures [record](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0000778).
- **GO glycinergic synaptic transmission** — vesicular glycine release/activation of postsynaptic receptors matches slc6a5/slc32a1 inhibitory-transmitter biology [record](https://zfin.org/GO%3A0060012).

## Caveats
- **Alternative 1:** hindbrain glycinergic/inhibitory neuron: slc6a5 has hindbrain-neuron expression, but the pax2a/slc6a5 curated overlap is stronger for spinal cord.
- **Alternative 2:** otic/neural Pax2a lineage: pax2a is otic/eye/pronephros-associated, but inhibitory vesicular/transporter markers argue against non-neuronal epithelium.

**Verdict:** spinal cord inhibitory interneuron, mature — confidence medium

transcript.content: Cluster 76's top up-regulated markers are: krt8, krt18a.1, mdka, pmp22a, col4a6, col4a5, igfbp7, gfap. Using ZFIN curated expression, ZFA anatomy, and GO, identify the most likely zebrafish cell type (with state if the markers support it), grounding each claim in a cited record. If the evidence is ambiguous, say so.

**Most likely radial glial / astroglial cell, with epithelial-ECM features; state not confidently assignable.**

## Evidence
- **gfap** — curated expression includes astrocyte/CNS astrocyte, Müller cell, telencephalon and spinal cord contexts; ZFA radial glial cell lists **gfap** among top expression-associated genes [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990914-3/expression), [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-TERM-100331-2349).
- **mdka** — expressed in nervous system/neural tube/neuroectoderm and acts in neural tube formation; supports neural progenitor/glial niche rather than simple epithelium [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990621-1).
- **krt8** — epithelial keratin: expressed in EVL, integument, neural tube and other structures; GO keratin filament is typically epithelial, making this a mixed epithelial/glial signature [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030411-5), [record](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO%3A0045095).
- **krt18a.1** — keratin partner expressed in EVL/periderm/head/cardiovascular system and active in keratin filament; reinforces epithelial/lining-cell character [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030411-6).
- **col4a6 / col4a5** — type IV collagen/basement-membrane ECM signal; GO collagen type IV trimers form networks within basement membranes [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-101001-2), [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030131-2281), [record](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO%3A0005587).
- **pmp22a** — peripheral myelin protein 22a is not specific enough here; ZFIN expression spans mesenchyme, myotome, fin and pharyngeal arch [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030131-6757).

## Caveats
- Keratins and basement-membrane collagens argue epithelial/ECM contamination or a specialized glial-lining cell.
- No cycling markers provided; do not call cycling/progenitor beyond ZFA radial-glia definition.

**Verdict:** radial glial / astroglial cell — confidence medium

Independent second read (alternative-hypothesis pass) for the same cluster:

**Best call: epithelial/barrier-associated cell, possibly basal-lamina/periderm-like; glial/radial-glial alternative is real but less supported.**

## Evidence
- **krt8** — strongest evidence for epithelial identity: ZFIN says it is expressed in EVL, integument, cardiovascular/sensory structures, and is predicted active in keratin filament; a curated publication reports krt8 expression in embryo surface envelope cells and later digestive epithelia. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030411-5) ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030411-5?utm_source=openai))
- **krt18a.1** — reinforces simple/embryonic epithelial identity: expressed in EVL, periderm, cardiovascular system, head, pleuroperitoneal region; predicted active in keratin filament. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030411-6) ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030411-6?utm_source=openai))
- **col4a5 / col4a6** — point to basement-membrane/ECM-producing epithelial or mesenchymal interface cells: both are collagen IV genes, predicted extracellular-matrix/basement-membrane components; **col4a6** is linked to basement membrane organization, and GO defines this as assembly/arrangement/disassembly of basement membrane constituents. [col4a5](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030131-2281), [col4a6](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-101001-2), [GO](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO%3A0071711) ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030131-2281?utm_source=openai))
- **gfap** — supports the main alternative: glial/radial-glial/neural-stem identity. ZFIN lists expression in nervous system, neural tube, neuronal stem cell, optic vesicle; GO places GFAP-type proteins in type III intermediate filaments. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990914-3), [GO](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO%3A0045098) ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990914-3?utm_source=openai))
- **mdka** — ambiguous: compatible with regenerative/neural progenitor or activated stromal programs; ZFIN records adult telencephalic neural-stem-cell work and activated hepatic stellate-cell expression, so it does not uniquely identify epithelium. [gene](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990621-1), [publication](https://zfin.org/ZDB-PUB-240828-2) ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990621-1?utm_source=openai))
- **pmp22a / igfbp7** — argue against a pure keratinocyte-only call: **pmp22a** is expressed in corneal endothelium, head mesenchyme, myotome, pectoral fin, pharyngeal arch; **igfbp7** is expressed in cardiovascular/CNS/notochord/hypochord/pleuroperitoneal regions and acts in angiogenesis. [pmp22a](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030131-6757), [igfbp7](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-040426-2423) ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030131-6757?utm_source=openai))

## Weighing alternatives
- **Most obvious: epithelial/periderm/EVL-like cell** — best supported by the paired keratins **krt8 + krt18a.1** and keratin/intermediate-filament biology.  
- **Alternative: glial/radial-glial/neural stem cell** — supported mainly by **gfap** and possibly **mdka**, but contradicted by strong epithelial keratin signal.  
- **Alternative: ECM/stromal or endothelial-associated cell** — supported by **col4a5/6**, **igfbp7**, **pmp22a**, but lacks a specific vascular or fibroblast marker in the provided list.

## Caveats
- Deepest defensible tier is **tissue/lineage: epithelial/barrier-associated**, not a precise cell type.
- Could be a mixed/doublet or transitional epithelial–glial/ECM state.

**Verdict:** epithelial/barrier-associated cell, mature/structural — confidence medium

**Most likely identity: mature neuron, probably CNS neuron; transmitter subtype unresolved.**

## Evidence
- **nrn1a** — curated expression includes neural tube, telencephalon, cranial ganglion, diencephalon, hindbrain, spinal cord, and neuron → neuronal identity. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/action/marker/ZDB-GENE-040718-212/expression?utm_source=openai))
- **stx1b** — expressed in nervous system/trigeminal placode; predicted at presynaptic active-zone membrane and involved in regulation of synaptic activity → synaptic neuron program. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-000330-4?utm_source=openai))
- **stxbp1a** — expressed in nervous system; predicted syntaxin-1 binding, vesicle docking/exocytosis and presynaptic dense-core vesicle exocytosis → presynaptic machinery. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-050626-106?utm_source=openai))
- **vamp2** — expressed in nervous system/head; predicted SNAP receptor/syntaxin-1 binding and SNARE-complex assembly → vesicle-release machinery. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030131-8225?utm_source=openai))
- **sncb** — curated expression in brain/CNS, cranial ganglion, neuron, retina and olfactory structures → neuronal/sensory-neural support. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-040426-1615/wt-expression?utm_source=openai))
- **tuba1c** — curated expression in nervous system, CNS, neuron and PNS across embryonic stages → neuronal cytoskeletal component. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/action/marker/ZDB-GENE-061114-1/expression?utm_source=openai))
- **GO/ZFA support** — “neuron” is the zebrafish anatomy term for impulse-receiving/conducting/transmitting nervous-tissue cells; GO terms “synapse,” “chemical synaptic transmission,” “synaptic vesicle exocytosis,” and “SNARE complex” match the stx1b/stxbp1a/vamp2 program. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0009248?utm_source=openai))

## Caveats
- **lhx1a** is broad: nervous system, mesoderm, renal system; it does not specify neuron subtype here. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-347?utm_source=openai))

## Evidence

[record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030131-4013) ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030131-4013?utm_source=openai))
- **sox10** — expressed in glioblast, nervous system, and neural crest; acts within glial cell differentiation, supporting glial/oligodendroglial identity but also neural-crest derivatives. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-011207-1) ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-011207-1?utm_source=openai))
- **qkia** — RNA-binding gene expressed in nervous system; GO-linked mRNA 3′-UTR binding fits post-transcriptional regulation, supportive but not diagnostic for oligodendrocytes. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990415-230) ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990415-230?utm_source=openai))

- **GO: oligodendrocyte differentiation/development** — defines oligodendrocytes as CNS myelinating glia and covers progression from commitment to functional differentiated cell. [record](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO%3A0014003) ([amigo.geneontology.org](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO%3A0014003?utm_source=openai))

[record](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/ontologies/zfa/classes/http%253A%252F%252Fpurl.obolibrary.org%252Fobo%252FZFA_0000016?lang=en) ([ebi.ac.uk](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/ontologies/zfa/classes/http%253A%252F%252Fpurl.obolibrary.org%252Fobo%252FZFA_0000016?lang=en&utm_source=openai))

If the evidence is ambiguous, say so.

**Most likely radial glial / neural progenitor-like cell, probably CNS/retinal stem-progenitor state — confidence medium.**

## Evidence
- **fabp7a** — brain fatty-acid-binding protein; expressed in nervous system/neural tube, and ZFA lists it among genes annotated to radial glial cell; GO supports fatty acid binding/transport. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-000627-1) [ZFA](https://zfin.org/ZDB-TERM-100331-2349)
- **mdka** — growth-factor gene expressed in nervous system, neural tube, and neuroectoderm; reported in retinal stem/progenitor and adult telencephalic radial-glial/NSC contexts, supporting progenitor niche identity. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990621-1) [publication](https://zfin.org/ZDB-PUB-121120-19)
- **mdkb** — midkine paralog; ZFIN literature links mdka/mdkb to retinal stem-cell niches during retinal development/regeneration, reinforcing stem/progenitor rather than mature neuron identity. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-010131-6) [publication](https://zfin.org/ZDB-PUB-090310-11)
- **lbx1b** — developmental neural TF marker; ZFIN mutant-expression records connect lbx1 genes to spinal inhibitory interneuron programs, so it may indicate regional neural patterning rather than glial maturity. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-FISH-150901-14053)
- **radial glial cell** — ZFA defines this as a developing-CNS cell functioning as both precursor and neuronal-migration scaffold. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-TERM-100331-2349)

## Caveats
- **prss35** and the CU/CR loci are not decisive from the canonical records available here.
- **lbx1b** introduces ambiguity toward neural-patterned progenitors/interneuron-lineage context, not a pure glial call.

**Verdict:** radial glial / neural progenitor-like cell, progenitor — confidence medium**

- No provided canonical mature neuronal markers; **lbx1b** prevents a clean radial-glia-only call.

**Most likely: posterior spinal sensory neurons, especially Rohon-Beard–like immature/maturing neurons.**

## Evidence
- **tlx2** — expressed in Rohon-Beard neurons, inner ear, and statoacoustic ganglion; its ZFIN description also places it in inner-ear development, supporting a sensory-neuronal rather than epithelial primordium identity [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-020208-1). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-020208-1?utm_source=openai))
- **elavl3** — pan-neuronal RNA-binding marker expressed in the nervous system/neural tube and involved in regulation of neurogenesis; Rohon-Beard neuron anatomy records list **elavl3** among genes with expression figures [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-76). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-76?utm_source=openai))
- **nrn1a** — expressed in nervous system/neural tube/trigeminal placode and predicted in neuron projection extension, consistent with differentiating neurons [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-040718-212). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-040718-212?utm_source=openai))
- **hoxb8a** — posterior axial/neural marker: expressed in nervous system and neural tube; hoxb8a perturbation affects posterior lateral line primordium migration, but the anatomy term defines that primordium as a migrating placodal group, not a neuron [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990415-108). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990415-108?utm_source=openai))
- **hoxb9a** — homeobox transcription factor; limited accessible ZFIN expression evidence here, but HOX activity fits posterior positional identity via DNA-binding transcription factor function [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990415-109). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990415-109?utm_source=openai))

## Caveats
- Posterior lateral line involvement is suggested by **hoxb8a**, but the cluster lacks canonical lateral-line primordium markers in the provided list.
- **tlx2 + elavl3 + nrn1a** favor sensory neurons; exact subtype should remain Rohon-Beard–like rather than definitive.

**Verdict:** Rohon-Beard–like posterior sensory neuron, mature — confidence medium

transcript.content: Cluster 83's top up-regulated markers are: tal1, gata3, nkx1.2lb, ptmaa, slc32a1, gata2a, stxbp1a, pbx1a. Using ZFIN curated expression, ZFA anatomy, and GO, identify the most likely zebrafish cell type (with state if the markers support it), grounding each claim in a cited record. If the evidence is ambiguous, say so.

**Kolmer–Agduhr / CSF-contacting GABAergic spinal interneuron, likely mature — driven by KA TFs plus inhibitory synaptic machinery.**

## Evidence
- **gata2a** — curated expression includes Kolmer–Agduhr neuron regions and VeLD regions, matching spinal inhibitory interneuron programs. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-260/expression) ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-260/expression?utm_source=openai))
- **gata3** — expressed in nervous system; gata3 mutants lose **gata2a/tal1/tal2** expression in Kolmer–Agduhr neuron regions, supporting KA-lineage relevance. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990415-82) ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990415-82?utm_source=openai))
- **tal1** — KA-region **tal1** expression is reported as absent in gata3 mutants, tying this cluster’s tal1/gata module to KA neurons. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-501/expression) ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-501/expression?utm_source=openai))
- **slc32a1** — vesicular inhibitory amino-acid transporter; expressed in inhibitory interneuron, spinal cord, and brain; GO-associated with GABA/glycine transport and neurotransmitter loading into synaptic vesicle. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-061201-1) ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-061201-1?utm_source=openai))
- **stxbp1a** — nervous-system synaptic vesicle/exocytosis gene, consistent with neuronal synaptic maturity. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-050626-106) ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-050626-106?utm_source=openai))
- **Kolmer–Agduhr neuron** — ZFA defines these as ciliated GABAergic neurons contacting the spinal central canal. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-TERM-100331-1915) ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-TERM-100331-1915?utm_source=openai))

## Caveats
- **nkx1-2b/nkx1.2lb** also supports nervous/neural tube identity, but is not KA-specific. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-040615-2) ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-040615-2?utm_source=openai))

**Verdict:** Kolmer–Agduhr GABAergic spinal interneuron, mature — confidence medium.

Independent second read (alternative-hypothesis pass) for the same cluster:

**Best call: spinal GABAergic CSF-contacting interneuron, likely Kolmer–Agduhr/VeLD-family; alternative hematovascular progenitor is weaker.**

## Evidence
- **slc32a1** — strongest cell-type anchor: vesicular inhibitory amino-acid transporter; expressed in inhibitory interneuron, brain, spinal cord, and supports GABA/glycine vesicle loading [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-061201-1).
- **gata3** — supports spinal inhibitory-neuron hypothesis: gata3 mutant phenotypes include fewer/absent GABAergic neurons in Kolmer–Agduhr regions and VeLD defects [record](https://zfin.org/action/marker/ZDB-GENE-990415-82/phenotype-summary).
- **tal1** — ambiguous: classic hematovascular marker, but tal1 mutants also lose/decrease gata3/tal2 and GABAergic KA/VeLD features, tying it to spinal inhibitory interneuron development here [record](https://zfin.org/action/marker/ZDB-GENE-980526-501/phenotype-summary).
- **gata2a** — ambiguous but concordant: expressed in hematopoietic system/mesoderm, yet ZFIN expression includes Kolmer–Agduhr regions and VeLD; acts within ventral spinal cord interneuron differentiation [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-260).
- **nkx1-2b** — neural support: expressed in nervous system and neural tube, with TF/cell-differentiation annotations [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-040615-2).
- **stxbp1a** — mature neuronal/synaptic support: expressed in nervous system; involved in vesicle docking/exocytosis [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-050626-106).
- **Kolmer–Agduhr neuron** — ZFA term fits: ciliated GABAergic spinal-cord central-canal-contacting neuron [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-TERM-100331-1915).
- **Alternative: hematovascular progenitor** — tal1/gata2a/pbx1a support hemopoiesis/vasculature, but slc32a1/stxbp1a/nkx1-2b and KA/VeLD phenotypes argue deeper than mesoderm [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-000405-1).

## Caveats
- Without down-regulated markers or atlas context, KA vs VeLD vs broader spinal GABAergic interneuron cannot be cleanly separated.

**Verdict:** spinal GABAergic interneuron, mature/developing — confidence medium**

Using ZFIN curated expression, ZFA anatomy, and GO, identify the most likely zebrafish cell type (with state if the markers support it), grounding each claim in a cited record. If the evidence is ambiguous, say so.

**Likely retinal bipolar neuron, mature/differentiating — strongest support is vsx2 + retinal INL/bipolar evidence with neuronal/synaptic maturation markers.**

## Evidence
- **vsx2** — expressed in optic cup/vesicle and retina; reporter labels retinal progenitors then outer INL cells, with bipolar-cell marker overlap; ZFA lists **retinal bipolar neuron** as a retina neuron connecting photoreceptors to inner plexiform layer neurons [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-001222-1) [figure](https://zfin.org/ZDB-FIG-090527-2) [anatomy](https://www.zfin.org/action/ontology/term/ZFA%3A0009318). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-001222-1?utm_source=openai))
- **lhx4** — reported in zebrafish retina from 48 hpf, in ONL and INL, and functionally tied to retinal neural differentiation; compatible with retinal interneuron/bipolar identity [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-060728-1). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-PUB-210123-21?utm_source=openai))
- **elavl4** — neuron-specific RNA-binding gene expressed in nervous system and acting within axonogenesis, supporting neuronal rather than glial/progenitor identity [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990415-246). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990415-246?utm_source=openai))
- **nrn1a** — expressed in nervous system; predicted involvement in **neuron projection extension**, a GO process defined as long-distance growth of a neuron projection [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-040718-212) [GO](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO%3A1990138). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-040718-212?utm_source=openai))
- **snap25a / gap43** — synaptic/axon-growth neuronal markers: snap25a is expressed in nervous system/optic vesicle; gap43 is expressed in nervous system and acts in axon regeneration, consistent with differentiating/mature neurons [snap25a](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-468) [gap43](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990415-87). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-468?utm_source=openai))

## Caveats
- **vsx2** also marks retinal progenitors and Müller lineage contexts; absence of subtype markers prevents ON/OFF or rod/cone bipolar subclassing.
- **sox14** is neural but not decisive here.

**Verdict:** retinal bipolar neuron, mature/differentiating — confidence medium

## Evidence
- **vsx2** — strongest split marker: curated retinal expression in retinal progenitors/outer INL, and later presumed bipolar cells; but also hindbrain/spinal-cord neuronal expression, so it supports both retinal bipolar and spinal interneuron hypotheses. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-FIG-090527-2?utm_source=openai))
- **vsx2 + ZFA** — retinal bipolar neuron is a defined ZFA cell type with vsx2 among genes with expression figures; this makes “retinal bipolar neuron” the most obvious specific hypothesis. ([zfin.org](https://www.zfin.org/action/ontology/term/ZFA%3A0009318?utm_source=openai))
- **vsx2 + ZFA alternative** — spinal cord interneuron/CiD-V2a is also plausible: ZFA defines spinal cord interneuron as a CNS interneuron in spinal cord, and CiD/V2a lists vsx2 among top expression-associated genes. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0000778?utm_source=openai))
- **elavl4** — neuron-specific RNA-binding gene, expressed in CNS/cranial ganglion/neuron; supports neuronal identity but not retina-vs-spinal specificity. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990415-246?utm_source=openai))
- **snap25a** — synaptic/neuronal program: expressed in head, nervous system, optic vesicle; supports differentiated neuron rather than progenitor alone. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-468?utm_source=openai))
- **gap43 / nrn1a** — neurite/axon-growth program: gap43 acts in axon/tissue regeneration and is expressed in nervous system; GO axonogenesis/neuron projection development matches this mature or growing-neuron state. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990415-87?utm_source=openai))
- **retina ZFA** — retina/neural retina are defined ZFA structures, but the marker set lacks stronger retinal subtype markers here, so tissue-level retina is not fully decisive. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0000152?utm_source=openai))

## Caveats
- **sox14/lhx4** add neural TF flavor but are not enough here to discriminate retinal bipolar from spinal interneuron.
- Deepest defensible tier: **CNS neuron**; specific subtype is ambiguous.

**Verdict:** CNS neuron, mature/neurite-growing — confidence medium
